hassium.configuration.title: %s Configuration
hassium.configuration.chunk.enabled.tool: Chunk-core master switch: on join the shadow server takes over world saving, lighting, and the local cache, fetching chunks on demand; when off the vanilla path is used everywhere (the server stops stripping light too). Default: on.
hassium.configuration.chunk.maxSizeMb.to: Disk cap for the local cache; when exceeded, the coldest region files (.mca, removed whole-file) are evicted by heat. Default: 4096 (4GB).
hassium.configuration.chunk.hotScoreThre: Region files whose heat (weighted by recency and visit frequency) is below this value are considered cold and evicted whole-file first. Default: 0.3.
hassium.configuration.chunk.recencyWeigh: Weight of "recently visited" in the heat score, paired with the frequency weight. Default: 0.7.
hassium.configuration.chunk.frequencyWei: Weight of "visit frequency" in the heat score. Default: 0.3.
hassium.configuration.chunk.cleanupInter: How often (in game ticks, 20 = 1s) the cache checks for overflow and cleans up. Default: 6000 (~5 minutes).
hassium.configuration.chunk.targetSizeMb: Size the cache is shrunk toward during cleanup; 0 = auto (max size × 0.8). Default: 0 (auto).
hassium.configuration.chunk.minCleanupBa: How many cold r.X.Z.mca files at most are deleted per cleanup pass. Default: 100.
hassium.configuration.chunk.sectionDelta: When the local cache is out of sync with the server, request only the changed 16×16×16 sections and merge them instead of re-fetching the whole chunk. Requires the chunk cache. Default: on.
hassium.configuration.chunk.viewDistance: When the client render distance exceeds the server view distance, fill the ring from the shadow-end local cache (local data only; never request out-of-range chunks from the server). Mutually exclusive with Bobby-style mods. Default: on.
hassium.configuration.chunk.maxRenderDis: Effective client render-distance cap for beyond-view render (2–64). Default: 16.
hassium.configuration.chunk.maxChunksPer: Per-tick cap on shadow cache-read production (shadow enqueue and disk loads). Main-thread apply is time-budget only; server push has its own throttle. Default: 6.
hassium.configuration.chunk.mainThreadCh: Time budget (ms) the main thread spends applying chunks per frame, preventing loading hitches. Default: 15.
hassium.configuration.chunk.seedGenEnabl: Shadow tracking triggers vanilla worldgen to generate pristine chunks locally from the world seed; results are delivered only after server-side authority comparison (compare-pull), instead of downloading them in full. Requires the matching option on the server and identical versions on both sides. Default: off.
hassium.configuration.debug.networkMetri: Collect metrics such as traffic and cache hit rate (view with /hassiumc stats). Default: off.
Reset the metric counters of the current session when leaving a server. Default: on.
hassium.configuration.debug.metadataLogg: chunkHash receive/compare/apply logs. Debug only. Default: off.
hassium.configuration.debug.dispatcherLo: Main-thread callback queue logs. Debug only. Default: off.
hassium.configuration.debug.asyncLogging: Background async task logs. Debug only. Default: off.
hassium.configuration.debug.compressionL: Compression / decompression logs. Debug only. Default: off.
hassium.configuration.debug.chunkApplyLo: Chunk apply logs. Debug only. Default: off.
hassium.configuration.debug.networkLoggi: Network send / receive logs. Debug only. Default: off.
hassium.configuration.debug.cacheLogging: Cache read / write logs. Debug only. Default: off.
Legacy key, equivalent to debug.lightLogging; either one enables light debug output. Kept for old configs only.
hassium.configuration.debug.lightLogging: Single switch for all light debugging: light pipeline logs ([SHADOW_LIGHT]/[LIGHT_GATE]), engine/light-packet probes ([CHUNK_PROBE] source=light, [LIGHT_CALL]) and the smoke lightProbe counters block. Debug only. Default: off.
hassium.command.export.no_connection: §cNot connected to a server; cannot determine the export target§r
